title: Requirement Document
content:
Requirement Documents
### Introduction
The product idea is to build a responsive dashboard UI only. This document outlines the requirements for the project.

### Functional Requirements
* The dashboard UI should be responsive and work on various devices and screen sizes
* The UI should be user-friendly and easy to navigate
* The dashboard should display key metrics and data visualizations
* The UI should be customizable to accommodate different user roles and preferences

### Non-Functional Requirements
* The dashboard UI should be fast and responsive, with a load time of less than 3 seconds
* The UI should be secure and follow best practices for data protection
* The dashboard should be accessible and follow Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1)

### User Requirements
* The dashboard UI should be easy to use and understand, with clear and concise labeling and instructions
* The UI should provide real-time updates and notifications
* The dashboard should allow users to customize their view and save their preferences

## 2.

title: Project Planning Document
content:
Project Planning Documents
### Project Overview
The project involves building a responsive dashboard UI only. The project will be completed in 4 weeks.

### Project Scope
* The project includes designing and developing a responsive dashboard UI
* The project excludes backend development, database integration, and testing

### Project Deliverables
* A fully functional and responsive dashboard UI
* A style guide and design documentation
* A development guide and code documentation

### Project Assumptions and Dependencies
* The project assumes that the design requirements will be provided by the client
* The project depends on the availability of the design team and the development team

## 3.

title: Technical Architecture & Delivery Plan
content:
Technical Architecture & Delivery Plans
### Technical Overview
The dashboard UI will be built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The UI will be designed using a responsive framework.

### Technical Requirements
* The UI will be built using a modular and scalable architecture
* The UI will use a CSS preprocessor and a JavaScript framework
* The UI will be optimized for performance and accessibility

### Technical Deliverables
* A fully functional and responsive dashboard UI
* A set of reusable UI components
* A technical guide and code documentation

### Technical Assumptions and Dependencies
* The project assumes that the development team has experience with responsive design and development
* The project depends on the availability of the development team and the design team

## 4.

title: Integrated Project Management Plan (IPMP)
content:
Integrated Project Management Plans (IPMP)
### Introduction
The IPMP outlines the project management approach and plan for the project.

### Project Organization
* The project will be managed by a project manager
* The project will have a design team and a development team

### Project Communication
* The project team will communicate using email, phone, and video conferencing
* The project team will have regular meetings and status updates

### Project Monitoring and Control
* The project will be monitored and controlled using agile methodologies
* The project will have regular sprint reviews and retrospectives

## 5.

title: Schedule & Cost Plan
content:
Schedule & Cost Plans
### Project Timeline
The project will be completed in 4 weeks.

### Project Schedule
* Week 1: Design and planning (5 days)
* Week 2-3: Development (10 days)
* Week 4: Testing and deployment (5 days)

### Project Budget
* The project budget is estimated to be $20,000
* The budget includes design, development, testing, and deployment costs

### Cost Breakdown
* Design: $4,000 (20% of the total budget)
* Development: $12,000 (60% of the total budget)
* Testing and deployment: $4,000 (20% of the total budget)

## 6.

title: Quality, Risk & Procurement Plan
content:
Quality, Risk & Procurement Plans
### Quality Plan
* The project will follow agile methodologies and best practices for quality assurance
* The project will have regular code reviews and testing

### Risk Plan
* The project risks include delays in design and development, and changes in requirements
* The project will mitigate risks by having regular meetings and status updates, and by having a flexible development approach

### Procurement Plan
* The project will procure design and development services from external vendors
* The project will follow a procurement process that includes RFP, evaluation, and selection

## 7.

title: Testing & Release Plan
content:
Testing & Release Plans
### Testing Plan
* The project will have unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
* The project will use automated testing tools and manual testing

### Release Plan
* The project will have a staged release plan, with alpha, beta, and production releases
* The project will have a rollback plan in case of issues or errors

### Deployment Plan
* The project will be deployed to a cloud-based infrastructure
* The project will have a deployment script and a backup plan

Note: The estimated timeline and budget are based on the complexity of the project, and may vary depending on the specific requirements and circumstances.

title: Screen Inventory
content:
Here is a suggested page list and structural component-based wireframe description for a responsive dashboard UI:

**Pages:**

1. Dashboard
2. Reports
3. Settings
4. Users
5. Profile

**Components:**

1. **Header**
	* Logo
	* Navigation menu (with dropdowns)
	* Search bar
	* User profile dropdown
2. **Sidebar**
	* Menu items (with icons)
	* Submenu items (with icons)
	* Collapse/expand button
3. **Grid**
	* Grid container
	* Grid items (with headers and content)
	* Pagination
4. **Form**
	* Form container
	* Form fields (with labels and input fields)
	* Form buttons (submit, cancel, etc.)
5. **Cards**
	* Card container
	* Card header
	* Card content
	* Card footer

**Dashboard Page:**

* Header
* Sidebar
* Grid (with 4-6 grid items)
* Cards (with key metrics and charts)

**Reports Page:**

* Header
* Sidebar
* Grid (with report data and filters)
* Form (for filtering and exporting reports)

**Settings Page:**

* Header
* Sidebar
* Form (with settings fields and buttons)

**Users Page:**

* Header
* Sidebar
* Grid (with user data and filters)
* Form (for adding and editing users)

**Profile Page:**

* Header
* Sidebar
* Form (with profile fields and buttons)

Here is a simple wireframe diagram:
```
  +---------------------------------------+
  |                  Header              |
  +---------------------------------------+
  |  Logo  |  Nav Menu  |  Search  |  User  |
  +---------------------------------------+
  |                  Sidebar             |
  |  Menu Item 1  |  Menu Item 2  |  ...  |
  |  Submenu Item 1  |  Submenu Item 2  |  ...  |
  +---------------------------------------+
  |                  Grid               |
  |  Grid Item 1  |  Grid Item 2  |  ...  |
  |  Pagination  |  ...  |
  +---------------------------------------+
  |                  Cards              |
  |  Card 1  |  Card 2  |  ...  |
  +---------------------------------------+
  |                  Form               |
  |  Form Field 1  |  Form Field 2  |  ...  |
  |  Form Button 1  |  Form Button 2  |  ...  |
  +---------------------------------------+
```
As for the PNG design, I'm a text-based AI and do not have the capability to generate images. However, I can provide you with a simple diagram using ASCII art, as shown above. You can use this as a starting point and create your own design using a tool like Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
